'''2012 Bespin Regionals Brandon Brist DS Combat Readiness (V)''' was the Dark Side constructed list played by [[Brandon Brist]] at [[2012 Bespin Regionals]] (Regionals).


== Deck info ==

* '''Starting Card:''' {{CardLink|Combat Readiness (V) (Dark)|VB4-D-combatreadiness-pre.gif|label=Combat Readiness / Full Scale Alert (V)}}
* '''Username:''' bristicles
* '''Format:''' [[Legacy Open]]
* '''Stage:''' Regionals
